notes.title: AWAKEN - Astral Blade is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/f286b28e783a31fadb1148eb3ea51c8944ad3891.png[/img]

Greetings!

We are thrilled to announce that [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b] is available now with a [b]limited-time 10% launch discount[/b]!! We have prepared a new trailer to celebrate the occasion and get everyone hyped up to jump into action.

[previewyoutube=DmGLIRJR-es;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to the standard digital PC release, gamers can also add the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] to their collection. This contains the AWAKEN - Astral Blade base game as well as the following additional digital content: a special Golden Scale Set, the original soundtrack by Alexandria Migova, and a Digital Artbook with concept art and illustrations from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/fd7152e4da82c0d7924c4ca3690b66eb8777078b.jpg[/img]

The time has come to join Tania on her most perilous mission yet, as she uncovers the ancient, dark secrets of a long-lost civilization on the mysterious Horace Islands. Weave your own story in this dark 2D side-scrolling action game, and use Tania’s speed, skills and weapons to defeat the deadly mutant animals and plants that have infested the island!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

If you don't want to miss any news and updates or just chat with us — [b][url=https://linktr.ee/ESDGames] join the official ESDigital social media accounts[/url][/b].

We are looking forward to seeing you in Jacha City!

notes.title: ESDigital Games are Singapore Bound for gamescom Asia 2024!
notes.notes:
We at ESDigital Games are excited to announce that we are continuing our autumn game event tour by [b]attending the upcoming gamescom Asia show in Singapore from 17-20 Octobe[/b]r!

[previewyoutube=yudQlm-jM0U;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be showcasing five action-packed titles from our Incredible Indie line-up, with playable versions available in both the Business Area  (booth BC05) and the Indie Entertainment Zone (booths IA 31-35). 

Attendees can get hands-on time with the stealth action game [b]Steel Seed[/b], action-packed Metroidvania-inspired [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b], complex alchemy RPG [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b], story-driven sci-fi adventure [b]Sky of Tides[/b] and the stunning action-adventure game [b]Island of Winds[/b]. 

See you there!

notes.title: REMEDIUM: Sentinels Unleashed Today! Embark on an Epic Adventure Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Today is THE DAY, fellow Sentinels![/b]
 
REMEDIUM: Sentinels has officially released, and we couldn't be more excited. Get ready to immerse yourself in an extraordinary experience filled with new features and improvements that have been implemented since the game's Early Access phase.
 
Prepare for an expanded world of possibilities as we introduce a range of exciting updates. We now boast an impressive roster of 8 playable Sentinels, each with their unique abilities and playstyles. Traverse meticulously crafted locations, soaking in the atmospheric environments that will captivate your senses. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal of weapons and upgrades to take on the hordes of adversaries that await. These additions were not available during the initial release, making the game even more engaging and dynamic.
 
But that's not all! We have gone above and beyond to enhance the player experience. Significant improvements have been made to the HUD and interface, ensuring smooth navigation and seamless interaction. Prepare to showcase your skills and compete with players globally through the introduction of world leaderboards. We are committed to making the leaderboards even more engaging and exciting for you! Additionally, we have expanded the list of achievements, satisfying the insatiable quest for glory of achievement hunters. And rest assured, we have plans to continue adding new achievements in the future.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/6768507d643c281c954e683ff69b5cad06ecedaa.jpg[/img]

To further enhance gameplay, we have implemented quality of life improvements. Discover new interactive objects that grant additional scores when standing nearby, providing strategic advantages in the heat of battle. For example, in the "Mines" level, now you have to push the minecart to earn points. To make it happen, the Sentinel needs to be next to it while fending off hordes of enemies (they haven't gone anywhere)! Furthermore, we have introduced additional elemental versions of weapons, each with its unique effects, bringing more diversity and dynamism to combat encounters.
 
Today's release of REMEDIUM: Sentinels marks an exciting milestone in our journey. We are determined to deliver an exceptional gaming experience, and we can't wait for you to join us. Embark on an unforgettable adventure of survival and discovery, and let the world of REMEDIUM: Sentinels captivate you.
 
Get ready to push your limits, showcase your skills, and become a true Sentinel. Today is the day we've been waiting for!
 
[b]Stay strong and PUSH THE PLAY BUTTON![/b]
